comments: Two changes combined on top of the best result so far (single-frame finetune, 0.3684 val dice) -- not an isolated single-variable test: (1) dataset regenerated with resize_extracted_dataset.py --dilate-radius 1 (kurals_datasets_local/KuRALS_CW_8x64_dense), marking a 3x3 neighborhood around each target's remapped coarse-grid cell instead of just the 1-2 cells the exact remap produces -- verified 2->12 positive cells for a sample target, still valid one-hot. (2) peak lr lowered 0.0001->0.00002 (5x) since fine-tuning from a good init usually wants a smaller step than training from scratch, which is what every prior run (including the 0.3684 finetune) reused unchanged. IMPORTANT: dice/precision from this run are NOT directly comparable to prior sparse-label (dilate_radius=0) numbers -- the ground-truth positive region itself is larger, so higher recall/dice here partly reflects an easier target, not only better predictions.
